findings: [8] «Копотл» (Kopotl) is evidently a slip for «Койотл» (Koyotl, 'Coyotl') in Nezahualcoyotl's name; rendered “Coyotl.”
[9] «Около 1460 года до Р. Хр.» ('about 1460 before the Nativity of Christ'): Nezahualcoyotl of Texcoco lived 1402–1472 A.D., so «до» ('before') is wrong in the print; translated as printed, “B.C.”
disposition: Retain the audited Russian source and SHA-256 unchanged. The English follows the printed reading (or its evident sense where marked) and the unit stays reviewed; Confirm against the printed volume 41 at the next print-witness pass.
